raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Preserve an exact direct P/D KV endpoint when every transfer-enabled replay group is loaded, while still replaying a missing Decode-only/local group. **Draft, stacked on and dependent on #59197.**

The branch contains exactly #59197's two prerequisite changes plus this follow-up, rebased onto main `710ac56e691d4713feca50a43e6c440f07d373fd`. **The two prerequisite commits will be removed after #59197 merges**, leaving only the endpoint fix for review and merge.

## Claims

- Keep `512 + 86 = 598` as the external-load endpoint instead of rounding the external hit to 64 and ending at 576. A missing local replay group still rebuilds from `598 - 128 = 470`.
- Avoid querying connector loaded-group state on a zero external hit.
- Retain the replay-start block at 32/64-token boundary-minus-one endpoints, with matching admission-memory accounting. The Mooncake regression preserves source pairing `8 -> 829`, `9 -> 499`.

## Validation

**Checks run on this new three-commit stack:** changed-file pre-commit passed across all nine changed Python files, including Ruff check/format, typos, mypy 3.10, SPDX/import/config checks, and Buildkite test tethering. Changed-file mypy 3.12, Python 3.12 compilation, AST parsing, and `git diff --check` also passed. Exact added/removed-line comparison passed for each of the three source-to-ported commits. The worktree is clean.

Commands run from the new worktree (zsh; compile-cache path abbreviated):

```sh
uv venv --python 3.12 .venv
uv pip install -r requirements/lint.txt
changed_files=("${(@f)$(git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD)}")
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files "${changed_files[@]}"
.venv/bin/pre-commit run mypy-3.12 --hook-stage manual --files "${changed_files[@]}"
PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX="/path/to/artifact-cache" .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q "${changed_files[@]}"
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
```

**Local pytest was intentionally not run.** The existing suites now include the exact endpoint/local replay, zero-hit, boundary-retention, and Mooncake source-pairing regressions. Their execution on this rebased stack remains pending:

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/core/test_prefix_replay.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_connector.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector_hma.py -v
```

**Prior GPU integration evidence, supplied by the submitter and checked against the existing validation report:** H20 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with Mooncake; TP8/PCP1 and TP4/PCP2 Prefill arms shared the fixed Decode overlay at source revision `24cc448760f1d7e412c32690a7f8229714861f09` (DP8/EP8, DSpark K5, Decode prefix caching and bounded replay enabled).

| Gate | TP8/PCP1 post-fix control | TP4/PCP2 integration candidate |
|---|---|---|
| EOS handoff | Passed | Passed |
| 8193-token cold/repeat Mooncake | Passed; identical 64 output token IDs | Passed; identical 64 output token IDs |
| Direct-client C16, three consecutive runs | 15/16 each; zero cross-associations, token caps, or infrastructure failures | 15/16 each; zero cross-associations, token caps, or infrastructure failures |
| GSM8K200 | 194/200; zero length finishes | 194/200; one PCP residual request reached the 65,536-token cap |
| P/D transfer metrics | Zero failed transfers, failed receives, or expired requests | Zero failed transfers, failed receives, or expired requests |

GSM8K used EvalScope 1.11.1, ModelScope GSM8K, four-shot prompts, limit 200, batch/concurrency 16, seed 42, temperature 0, top-p 1, reasoning effort high, and max tokens 65,536. The candidate's broader PCP correctness gate remains incomplete despite matching numerical accuracy. These GPU runs used integration overlays containing additional changes; GPU validation has not been rerun on the newly rebased upstream stack. No isolated performance improvement or general PCP support is claimed here.

## Details

The old replay decision required every replay group to appear in connector loaded-group IDs before preserving an unaligned external endpoint. A Decode-only group with `enable_kv_transfer=False` therefore forced a valid 86-token direct hit down to 64 tokens. Prefill ended at 598, while Decode allocated for 576, shifting Mooncake's tail-aligned source pairing.

Separate the conditions: loaded transfer-enabled replay groups determine whether to preserve the exact endpoint; all replay groups determine whether replay can be skipped. A missing local group keeps replay enabled without shrinking the peer endpoint. Bounded-replay sliding windows retain one additional token, and the admission bound includes that retention.

Stack mapping:

| Source | Ported commit | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `4b8d4c186699801a94157189a283c6c864fc81fd` | `6f1959930b76e9284eb4c1f8f213b8d693a83fc3` | #59197 loaded-window replay contract |
| `58f4a61f258aac28b227015ce5fd62ac3f9e3a7c` | `438cfbc0ee80367faa1777983060e38b0537c330` | #59197 bounded-replay N-1 handoff |
| `24cc448760f1d7e412c32690a7f8229714861f09` | `4e8385161e1fd5f0da43dc4894d34b7c70e4b303` | Five-file exact-endpoint follow-up |

Review the follow-up separately at [4e8385161e](https://github.com/wangyicong52/vllm/commit/4e8385161e1fd5f0da43dc4894d34b7c70e4b303). One Mooncake test-context conflict was resolved by keeping only the exact pairing regression. No PCP, DSpark-local-group connector changes, stopped-Prefill changes, compressor-ring fixes, or instrumentation commits were imported.

Duplicate audit refreshed on 2026-10-05: open searches for bounded replay, replay groups, loaded groups, exact KV endpoints, Mooncake, and #59197 references found no PR covering this local-only-group endpoint loss. #59197 is the prerequisite rather than a competing submission. #59330 covers general N-1 handoff and empty pulls. #58504 covers partial replay-hit boundary retention, which overlaps the retention concern but does not distinguish transferable windows from a missing local-only group. Reconcile overlapping retention/handoff changes if those PRs land first; refresh the stack and rerun the affected regressions after #59197 merges or changes.

AI assistance (Codex) was used to extract the existing validated fix, resolve the test-context conflict, run static checks, and prepare this draft. Every stacked commit includes Signed-off-by; the follow-up also credits Codex. The human submitter retains responsibility for line-by-line review and final validation before marking the PR ready.
